title: Morgan Stanley leads TMT M&A advisory by deal value in H1 2026
title_zh: 摩根士丹利在 2026 年上半年交易金额方面领先 TMT 并购咨询公司
summary: Houlihan Lokey led by deal volume in H1 2026, advising on 34 transactions across the TMT sector.
summary_zh: Houlihan Lokey 在 2026 年上半年的交易量方面处于领先地位，为 TMT 行业的 34 笔交易提供了咨询服务。

title: Is Bloom Energy (BE) Undervalued After JPMorgan Backed Its Brookfield AI Power Deal?
title_zh: 摩根大通支持其布鲁克菲尔德人工智能电力交易后，布鲁姆能源 (BE) 的价值是否被低估？
summary: Bloom Energy (BE) is back in focus after JPMorgan reaffirmed its positive stance on the stock, highlighting strong interest from technology firms in off grid power and a larger partnership with Brookfield. See our latest analysis for Bloom Energy.
summary_zh: 摩根大通重申了对 Bloom Energy (BE) 股票的积极立场，突显了科技公司对离网电力的强烈兴趣以及与布鲁克菲尔德建立更大的合作伙伴关系，之后布鲁姆能源 (BE) 重新成为人们关注的焦点。请参阅我们对 Bloom Energy 的最新分析。

title: KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Weighs Sale or Merger Options
title_zh: KKR 房地产金融信托考虑出售或合并选择
summary: KKR Real Estate Finance Trust weighs a sale, merger, or asset sale as loan losses mount, signaling growing strain on mortgage REITs.
summary_zh: 随着贷款损失的增加，KKR 房地产金融信托公司会权衡出售、合并或资产出售，这表明抵押贷款房地产投资信托基金面临的压力越来越大。

title: Wall Street Banks Trading Parts of $35 Billion AI Chip Deal
title_zh: 华尔街银行交易部分 350 亿美元人工智能芯片交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Wall Street banks have started buying and selling an initial piece of a $35 billion financing package for Broadcom Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——华尔街银行已开始买卖博通公司 350 亿美元融资计划的初始部分。

title: AMD, Cerebras Strike AI Chip Deals
title_zh: AMD 与 Cerebras 达成人工智能芯片交易
summary: Advanced Micro Devices and Cerebras Systems on Wednesday separately announced partnerships related to their AI chips. AMD stock and Cerebras stock rose on the news as semiconductor stocks overall advanced.
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices 和 Cerebras Systems 周三分别宣布了与其人工智能芯片相关的合作伙伴关系。随着半导体股整体上涨，AMD 股票和 Cerebras 股票受此消息上涨。
